tasks.title: Setup Dashboard Frontend Framework
tasks.description: Initialize and configure the React/Next.js frontend framework with responsive design for the Performance Monitoring Dashboard
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project using `npx create-next-app@latest`
2. Configure project structure following best practices:
   - `/components` for reusable UI components
   - `/pages` for route-based components
   - `/hooks` for custom React hooks

   - `/utils` for helper functions
   - `/context` for React context providers

tasks.title: Set Up Redis for Real-time Data Caching
tasks.description: Configure Redis as a real-time data cache for the dashboard to ensure <1 second data refresh latency
tasks.details:

2. Implement Redis client in the backend using ioredis or node-redis
3. Create data caching strategies:
   - Set up TTL (Time-To-Live) for different data types
   - Implement cache invalidation patterns
   - Configure pub/sub channels for real-time updates
4. Create cache service with methods:
   - `setMetricData(key, data, ttl)`
   - `getMetricData(key)`
   - `invalidateCache(pattern)`
   - `publishUpdate(channel, data)`
   - `subscribeToUpdates(channel, callback)`
5. Implement cache warming for frequently accessed data
6. Set up Redis monitoring and health checks
7. Configure Redis persistence for data recovery
8. Implement connection pooling for high throughput
9. Create cache hit/miss metrics for performance monitoring
tasks.testStrategy:

tasks.title: Setup Next.js 14+ Project with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS
tasks.description: Initialize the frontend project using Next.js 14+ with TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, including dark/light mode support and responsive design configuration.
tasks.details:
1. Create a new Next.js project with TypeScript:
```bash
npx create-next-app@latest --typescript
```
2. Install and configure Tailwind CSS:
```bash
npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
npx tailwindcss init -p
```
3. Configure Tailwind CSS in tailwind.config.js to include dark mode support:
```javascript
module.exports = {
  darkMode: 'class',
  content: [
    './pages/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}',
    './components/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}',
    './app/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}',
  ],
  theme: {
    extend: {},
  },
  plugins: [],
}
```
4. Create theme context for dark/light mode toggle functionality
5. Setup responsive design utilities and breakpoints
6. Configure project structure with appropriate folders for components, hooks, contexts, and utilities
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Verify Next.js application builds successfully
2. Test dark/light mode toggle functionality across different screen sizes
3. Validate responsive design using browser dev tools
4. Run Lighthouse audit to ensure accessibility and performance standards
5. Verify TypeScript configuration is working correctly

```typescript
import { createClient } from 'redis';

const redisClient = createClient({
  url: process.env.REDIS_URL || 'redis://localhost:6379'
});

redisClient.on('error', (err) => console.log('Redis Client Error', err));

await redisClient.connect();
```

tasks.title: Configure Deployment and CI/CD Pipeline
tasks.description: Set up deployment configuration for Vercel, Docker containerization, environment-based configuration, and automated CI/CD pipeline for the dashboard application.
tasks.details:
1. Create Vercel configuration:
```json
// vercel.json
{
  "version": 2,
  "builds": [
    {
      "src": "frontend/package.json",
      "use": "@vercel/next"
    },
    {
      "src": "backend/index.ts",
      "use": "@vercel/node"
    }
  ],
  "routes": [
    {
      "src": "/api/(.*)",
      "dest": "backend/index.ts"
    },
    {
      "src": "/(.*)",
      "dest": "frontend/$1"
    }
  ]
}
```
2. Create Docker configuration:
```dockerfile
# Frontend Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS frontend
WORKDIR /app
COPY frontend/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY frontend .
RUN npm run build

# Backend Dockerfile
FROM node:18-alpine AS backend
WORKDIR /app
COPY backend/package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY backend .
RUN npm run build

# Docker Compose for local development
# docker-compose.yml
version: '3'
services:
  frontend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.frontend
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    environment:
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://backend:4000
      - NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_URL=ws://backend:4000
  backend:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.backend
    ports:
      - "4000:4000"
    environment:
      - REDIS_URL=redis://redis:6379
  redis:
    image: redis:alpine
    ports:
      - "6379:6379"
```
3. Set up environment configuration for different environments
4. Configure GitHub Actions for CI/CD:
```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci.yml
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, develop ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, develop ]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '18'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend && npm ci
          cd ../backend && npm ci
      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd frontend && npm test
          cd ../backend && npm test
  
  deploy:
    needs: test
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Deploy to Vercel
        uses: amondnet/vercel-action@v20
        with:
          vercel-token: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_TOKEN }}
          vercel-org-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_ORG_ID }}
          vercel-project-id: ${{ secrets.VERCEL_PROJECT_ID }}
          vercel-args: '--prod'
```
5. Set up monitoring and logging for production
6. Create deployment documentation
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Test Vercel deployment with staging environment
2. Verify Docker containers build and run correctly
3. Test CI/CD pipeline with test commits
4. Verify environment configuration works across environments
5. Test monitoring and logging setup
6. Perform end-to-end testing in staging environment before production deployment
